scope: All saved refinement replay and research coordinators in this cohort
host_requirement: Mac awake and lid open; caffeinate prevents only idle sleep, not clamshell/explicit sleep or shutdown
failure_retention: Earlier saved replay remains failed and is not used as a passing preflight; all five saved cases rerun from their original independent snapshots
source_gate: Freeze after the whole-iteration output reference fix and archive audit pass independent review and are committed; reinstall, rerun all five saved inputs and saved audits, then roll back to BASE before research.
